sections.title: Decisions and current evidence
sections.note: Historical decisions remain on file. Validity columns reflect the current records, which can change after closure.
sections.sql: select email,application,entitlement,reviewer_email,decision,rationale,decided_at,keep_valid,removal_verified from access.review_queue where campaign_id=$1 order by email

sections.title: Imported source rows
sections.note: Source outcomes are retained history, never local certification.
sections.sql: select s.source_key,s.payload from access.source_rows s join access.reviews r on r.id=s.review_id where r.campaign_id=$1 order by s.source_key

sections.title: Remove and verify in the owning application
sections.note: Internal worklist only. Nothing has been sent or revoked by this document.
sections.sql: select q.email,q.application,q.entitlement,q.rationale,q.removal_verified,v.verifier_email,v.checked_on,v.evidence_ref from access.review_queue q left join access.removal_checks v on v.review_id=q.id where q.campaign_id=$1 and q.decision='remove'
